name: @we-the-rebel-alliance/voice-plugin
description: Local voice for OpenCode: report the speech engine, models and microphone, and speak text aloud on the machine.

scripts.check: npm run bundle && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:host && npm run conformance && npx plugin-kit check && npm run test:pack

plugin.name: voice
plugin.title: Voice
plugin.summary: Local voice: report the speech engine, models, microphone and next step, and speak text aloud on this machine. Dictation happens in the terminal UI, not through a tool. Audio stays on this machine and no recording is kept. Not for transcribing an audio file (a collector plugin) or meetings.

access.title: Access
access.description: How much the plugin's methods may do: everything, ask before a change, or reads only.

allowUntestedHost.title: Allow an untested host
allowUntestedHost.description: Start outside the tested OpenCode range.

aurumPath.title: Engine binary
aurumPath.description: An Aurum binary to use instead of the pinned engine. It is labelled unverified unless its digest matches.

assetsDir.title: Pre-seeded model folder
assetsDir.description: A pre-seeded model folder. Files are taken from here and nothing is downloaded.

submit.title: Dictation submit mode
submit.description: Send a transcript at once, or open a prefilled review dialog first.

keybind.title: Dictation key
keybind.description: The dictation key, in OpenCode's keymap syntax. Defaults to ctrl+shift+space on macOS and ctrl+space elsewhere.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The local text-to-speech voice, passed to the engine as --voice.

sttModel.title: Speech-to-text model
sttModel.description: The local speech-to-text model, as Aurum names it.

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: A spoken language code such as en or pt-BR, or auto.

maxRecordSeconds.title: Longest recording
maxRecordSeconds.description: The longest one recording may run, in whole seconds from 5 to 120.

statusIndicator.title: Listening indicator
statusIndicator.description: Where the listening state shows: a toast, or a row above the prompt.

keepTranscripts.title: Keep transcripts
keepTranscripts.description: Keep the last 20 transcripts as text in the plugin's storage. Audio is never kept.
